thread:
Jordan (Acme): Hey team — after our SSO/SCIM cutover this morning, our org can't view audit logs or exports. Every user (even admins) gets a 403 'You don't have permission to view audit logs'. Compliance export window is today, this is urgent.

Heather (Support): Thanks Jordan — on it. Can you confirm whether this is SAML + SCIM or OIDC? And a sample user email/org-id would help.

Jordan (Acme): SAML + SCIM. Org id: acme-1234. Example admin: jane.doe@acme.com. Error is a UI toast but also shows in network call: 403 from /api/v1/orgs/acme-1234/audit/logs.

Heather (Support): Got it. Triage plan: 1) try to repro with the org id, 2) check SCIM provisioning logs for group->entitlement mapping, 3) check org entitlements and retention flags. @Samir can you run entitlement & SCIM-sync checks for acme-1234?

Samir (SRE): Running now. Quick scan of SCIM sync logs shows provisioning events but I see a mapping gap. Snippet:

```
[scim-sync] 2025-11-02T14:12:03Z INFO provision group=auditors externalId=auditors_acme -> mapped_role=auditor
[ent-mapper] WARN missing entitlement mapping for role=auditor (expected entitlement 'audit_read')
[provision] 2025-11-02T14:12:04Z INFO user=jane.doe@acme assigned roles=[auditor]
```

And the API response from the UI repro: 

```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{
  "error": "access_denied",
  "message": "You don't have permission to view audit logs"
}
```

Heather (Support): That WARN indicates SCIM created the group/role but our entitlement transformer didn't map it to `audit_read`. @Priya any recent changes to entitlement mapping rules?

Priya (Security): Yes — we shipped a stricter mapping rule last week that requires an extension claim `role_ext` or the group displayName to match a whitelist. If the incoming SCIM group doesn't include `urn:redwood:role_ext` or one of the approved names, the entitlement is not granted. Looks like Acme's IdP isn't sending that extension.

Jordan (Acme): We didn't change group names. This worked pre-cutover. Our SCIM provider sent only name/displayName and members, no custom extension.

Samir (SRE): I also queried the org entitlements endpoint for acme-1234:

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/acme-1234/entitlements" | jq '.'
```

Response included: 

```
{
  "entitlements": {
    "audit.logs.view": false,
    "compliance.retention_enabled": false
  }
}
```

So both audit view and retention flags are false/missing. That explains empty exports.

Heather (Support): Okay — two separate but related issues: 1) entitlement mapping gap (SCIM->entitlement), 2) retention flag not enabled for exports. We can do an emergency manual grant for an admin to unblock compliance exports while we remediate. Priya, can you approve a temporary grant for jane.doe@acme?

Priya (Security): Approve emergency grant for 24h for `audit.logs.view` on acme-1234. Please log it.

Heather (Support): Done — I applied a 24-hour grant for `audit.logs.view` to jane.doe@acme and enabled `compliance.retention_enabled` temporarily. Audit log: 

AuditBot: Support action recorded: granted `audit.logs.view` to jane.doe@acme by Heather (Support) for 24h (ticket SEC-4321).

Jordan (Acme): Confirmed — jane.doe can now see exports and download the CSV. Thanks.

Samir (SRE): Next steps to fix root cause: 1) update entitlement-transformer to fall back to group displayName mapping when `role_ext` missing (short-term), 2) publish guidance for IdP/SCIM mapping to include `urn:redwood:role_ext` (long-term). I've opened PR #462 in infra: entitlement-transformer to implement fallback. Deployed to staging — smoke tests pass: mapping 'auditors' -> `audit_read` now.

Priya (Security): I've created SEC-4321 with scope: entitlement transformer rollback guardrail, add telemetry for missing role_ext claims, and customer outreach docs. Schedule for canary deploy tonight at 02:00 UTC.

Heather (Support): I'll send Acme the immediate remediation steps:
- Confirm SCIM group names include the expected displayName (e.g., `auditors`) or add `urn:redwood:role_ext` claim with value `audit_access`
- Test via `GET /v1/orgs/{org}/entitlements` after SCIM sync
- Contact support if mapping still missing after next sync

Sample cURL we gave them to validate entitlement: 

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/acme-1234/entitlements" | jq '.'
```

And sample SCIM extension to include in IdP: `urn:redwood:role_ext: "audit_access"`

Jordan (Acme): Can you share docs for the SCIM mapping? My IdP team needs the exact attribute name.

Heather (Support): Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/enterprise/scim-entitlements — includes examples for Okta/OneLogin/SailPoint and the `urn:redwood:role_ext` extension.

Samir (SRE): Deploy update: entitlement-transformer PR merged to canary, running in prod canary now. Mapping telemetry shows acme group mapped correctly. Will monitor for next 2 sync cycles (approx 15m).

AuditBot: Event: entitlement-transformer mapping success for org=acme-1234 group=auditors -> entitlement=audit.logs.view at 2025-11-02T16:05:12Z.

Heather (Support): Jordan — please keep me posted after your IdP update. We'll close the emergency grant after 24h and verify SCIM fix persists. If you need longer, we can extend but we prefer fixing at the mapping level.

Jordan (Acme): Thanks everyone. Confirmed with our IdP team — adding `urn:redwood:role_ext` to the group now. Will report back once sync runs. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :pray:

Heather (Support): Marking thread as actionable: SEC-4321 created, PR #462 deployed to canary, emergency grant applied and verified. Follow-up: Samir will promote transformer fix to prod after monitoring. Priya will own the security ticket. I'll follow up with the customer in 6h.

Samir (SRE): Quick note for internal: root cause summary for the ticket — entitlement-transformer stricter validation + missing SCIM `role_ext` claim caused audit_read entitlement to be withheld; retention flag also absent because provisioning group's legal/compliance role wasn't present. Remediation: fallback mapping + customer IdP attr guidance.

AuditBot: Thread closed for external comms; internal ticket SEC-4321 remains open.
